scripts.//env: Next only auto-loads .env from this directory, so the monorepo's root .env is injected via dotenv-cli — matching how @store/database loads it. NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars are inlined at build time, so `build` needs it too, not just `dev`.
scripts.//node-env: The root .env sets NODE_ENV=development for the API. It must NOT reach `build` or `start`: Next would load its development React runtime and prerendering fails outright. dotenv-cli does not overwrite a variable already present in the environment, so the inline NODE_ENV below wins.
